name: Music Organizer
author: nd-organizer
description: Organizes your Navidrome library: classifies albums (Soundtrack > Various Artist > Singles > Normal) and renames folders/files to your schemas, preserving live/bootleg recordings. Refreshes tags + artwork from MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, iTunes and Last.fm; reads/writes Kodi NFO sidecars; verifies identity (AcoustID fingerprint + tags + names) before writing. Integrates with Lidarr (metadata, naming schema, force-search incomplete albums) and AudioMuse-AI (acoustic tags, re-sync). Dry-run default, change history with rollback, metadata backups, reports + status feed (log webhook). Runs in idle-only batches and rescans Navidrome after moves so playback never hits stale files.

library.reason: Read, tag and rename music files inside library folders. Write access must be granted via the CLI (navidrome plugin edit nd-organizer --write-access).

http.reason: Fetch metadata/artwork from MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, iTunes, Last.fm, AcoustID, Lidarr and AudioMuse-AI. Wildcard required for user-configured Lidarr/AudioMuse URLs.

taskqueue.reason: Process one album per background task (callbacks are time-limited).

scheduler.reason: Run the organizer on a schedule and on startup.

subsonicapi.reason: Trigger Navidrome rescans (startScan) after path changes so the player never streams stale filenames.

users.reason: Resolve the scan user for startScan.

kvstore.reason: Cache external metadata responses and audio fingerprints.

cache.reason: Session cache for external metadata lookups.

storage.reason: Write run reports and persistent state.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: dryRun computes and reports the full change plan without writing anything. Switch to apply once you have reviewed a dry-run report.

scheduleCron.title: Schedule (cron)
scheduleCron.description: Cron expression for recurring runs, e.g. "0 3 * * 1" (weekly). Empty disables scheduling.

maxAlbumsPerRun.title: Max albums per run
maxAlbumsPerRun.description: How many albums to consider in one scheduled pass.

albumsPerTask.title: Albums per task (batch size)
albumsPerTask.description: Each background task only plans a small batch of albums, keeping the plugin lean so playback is never starved.

runOnlyWhenIdle.title: Only run when nothing is playing
runOnlyWhenIdle.description: Checks Navidrome getNowPlaying before doing work; if playback is active, the run is deferred and retried. Requires a scanUser the plugin can act as.

rollbackRunId.title: Rollback run ID
rollbackRunId.description: Set to a run ID (from the log, e.g. run-1755000000) to undo that run's changes on the next pass: restore backup metadata, rename files back, move folders back. Clear it afterwards. Runs are idempotent - already-rolled-back runs are skipped.

logWebhookUrl.title: Log webhook URL
logWebhookUrl.description: Optional. Each run's report and status are POSTed here as plain text - use a hosted log/notifier (ntfy, Gotify, Discord webhook, Loki push endpoint, ...). The plugin settings UI cannot render links; open this service's own dashboard/URL to view the log.

logWebhookToken.title: Log webhook token
logWebhookToken.description: Optional token sent as X-Token and Authorization: Bearer headers.

nestBucketsUnderVarious.title: Nest soundtracks under the Various Artist folder
nestBucketsUnderVarious.description: Soundtracks go under Various Artist/Sound Tracks/... when on, or as a top-level Sound Tracks/ folder when off. (Singles are not affected - they always go under the single's artist per the 'Put singles under the artist' option.)

singlesUnderArtist.title: Put singles under the artist's own folder
singlesUnderArtist.description: Artist/Singles/{title} instead of the Various Artist singles area. Falls back to Various Artist/Singles when the artist is unknown.

preserveRecordingType.title: Preserve live/bootleg recording type
preserveRecordingType.description: Detect live/bootleg tracks from tags (LIVE/BOOTLEG, genre, title markers) and suffix files/folders with (Live)/(Bootleg) so they never collide with or get confused as the studio release.

incompleteAlbumMinTracks.title: Incomplete album min tracks
incompleteAlbumMinTracks.description: Albums with fewer tracks than this (when no MusicBrainz match exists) are routed to the Singles folder.

classifyFromMB.title: Prefer MusicBrainz for classification
classifyFromMB.description: Use MusicBrainz release type (Soundtrack/Compilation/Single) when an album matches; fall back to local tag heuristics otherwise.

readNfo.title: Read NFO sidecars (album.nfo / artist.nfo)
readNfo.description: Use Kodi-style NFO files to fill metadata the APIs can't provide (styles, moods, custom fields). Tags still take priority.

writeNfo.title: Write/update NFO sidecars after collecting metadata
writeNfo.description: Rewrite album.nfo / artist.nfo with the metadata gathered during a run.

backupBeforeWrite.title: Back up metadata before tag/NFO writes
backupBeforeWrite.description: Snapshot previous tags and original .nfo to plugin storage before editing. Metadata only - never copies audio files.

backupRetentionDays.title: Backup/report retention (days)
backupRetentionDays.description: Auto-prune old backups, reports and logs older than this. 0 = keep forever.

folderSchema.title: Album folder schema
folderSchema.description: Path template for normal albums. Supported placeholders: {albumArtist} {album} {year} {genre} {mbid} {artist} {title}. '/' creates nested folders.

fileSchema.title: Track file schema
fileSchema.description: File name template (extension appended automatically). Placeholders: {track} {disc} {title} {artist} {album} {albumArtist} {year} {genre} {mbid}. Use {track:02}/{disc:02} for zero-padding.

renameSidecars.title: Rename sidecar files too
renameSidecars.description: Move .lrc/.jpg/.nfo files alongside renamed audio files.

pruneEmptyDirs.title: Delete empty source folders after moving

illegalCharReplacement.title: Illegal filename char replacement
illegalCharReplacement.description: Character used to replace characters that are illegal in filenames ( \ / : * ? " < > | ).

excludePaths.title: Exclude paths (never touch)
excludePaths.description: Directory prefixes or "prefix/*" globs under the library root that are skipped entirely (e.g. ["inbox", "Downloads/*"]).

verifyIdentity.title: Verify identity before tagging
verifyIdentity.description: Require multi-signal verification (AcoustID fingerprint, embedded tags, file/folder names, metadata analysis) before writing any tags or renaming.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Below this weighted signal score a track is skipped and reported as unverified.

skipUnverified.title: Skip unverified tracks
skipUnverified.description: Never tag or rename files that fail verification. They are listed in the report.

musicbrainzToken.title: MusicBrainz token
musicbrainzToken.description: Optional. Raises the rate limit from ~1 to ~50 requests/sec.

lastfmApiKey.title: Last.fm API key
lastfmApiKey.description: Optional. Used for genres and user playcounts.

lastfmUser.title: Last.fm username
lastfmUser.description: Used with lastfmApiKey to pull user playcounts.

overwriteExistingTags.title: Overwrite existing tags
overwriteExistingTags.description: When false, only fill missing fields; existing values are kept.

writePlaycount.title: Write playcounts from Last.fm
writePlaycount.description: Write user playcount/listener data into tags (POPM counter for MP3, PLAYCOUNT/LISTENERS keys otherwise).

overwriteArt.title: Replace existing artwork
overwriteArt.description: When false, existing embedded/sidecar art is kept if present.

downloadLyrics.title: Download lyrics files
downloadLyrics.description: Fetch and save synchronized lyrics (.lrc) next to each track.

lidarrUrl.title: Lidarr URL
lidarrUrl.description: e.g. http://lidarr:8686. Empty disables Lidarr integration.

lidarrMode.title: Lidarr mode
lidarrMode.description: For Lidarr-tracked artists the Lidarr layout and tags are authoritative; the plugin reports discrepancies instead of moving/tagging them.

writeTagsForTracked.title: Write tags for Lidarr-tracked albums
writeTagsForTracked.description: Escape hatch: allow the plugin to write tags even for tracked albums. Off by default to avoid fighting Lidarr.

lidarrForceSearchIncomplete.title: Force-search incomplete albums in Lidarr
lidarrForceSearchIncomplete.description: When an album is missing tracks and is monitored in Lidarr, trigger a Lidarr AlbumSearch so it downloads the missing tracks.

useLidarrNamingSchema.title: Use Lidarr's naming schema for folders/files
useLidarrNamingSchema.description: Use Lidarr's naming config (artistFolderFormat/albumFolderFormat/standardTrackFormat) instead of the organizer's folderSchema/fileSchema. Requires lidarrUrl + lidarrApiKey.

audiomuseUrl.title: AudioMuse-AI URL
audiomuseUrl.description: e.g. http://192.168.3.203:8000. Empty disables AudioMuse-AI integration.

notifyAudiomuseAfterRun.title: Trigger AudioMuse-AI re-sync after renames
notifyAudiomuseAfterRun.description: Keeps AudioMuse-AI analysis valid after files move.

writeAcousticTags.title: Write acoustic tags (BPM/key/mood/energy)
writeAcousticTags.description: Pulls tempo/key/mood/energy from AudioMuse-AI (needs the acoustic-tags side plugin installed there).

scanUser.title: Scan user
scanUser.description: Navidrome admin username used to trigger startScan.

triggerScanAfterRun.title: Trigger Navidrome scan after each run

scanAfterAlbum.title: Scan after each album with path changes
scanAfterAlbum.description: Instantly rescans so the player never calls old filenames.

scanDebounceSeconds.title: Scan debounce (seconds)
scanDebounceSeconds.description: 0 = immediate scan after each changed album.

elements.text: Activity is tracked automatically: the latest run status is stored under status:latest and the latest full report under report:latest in the plugin KVStore (plugins/nd-organizer/kvstore.db), and logged to the Navidrome server log. Optionally push each run's report/status to a hosted log via the webhook below.
